e.summary: 经济学文献库的保险分类入口：JEL G22「保险；保险公司；精算研究」+ NEP-IAS 保险经济学报告
e.summary_en: The economics literature library’s insurance gateway: JEL G22 "Insurance; Insurance Companies; Actuarial Studies" plus the NEP-IAS insurance economics report
e.summary_hk: 經濟學文獻庫的保險分類入口：JEL G22「保險；保險公司；精算研究」+ NEP-IAS 保險經濟學報告
e.body:
RePEc（Research Papers in Economics）及其门户 IDEAS（`ideas.repec.org`）是**经济学与金融研究的全球文献库**，其按 **JEL 分类**浏览的 **G22「Insurance; Insurance Companies; Actuarial Studies」（保险；保险公司；精算研究）**页面是**保险与精算学术文献的规范入口**——把工作论文、期刊文章、书籍章节与软件按学科编码归集（G22 隶属 G2「金融机构与服务」，上承 G「金融经济学」；榜单分页与「follow this JEL code」订阅均可核实）。平台另有几项对本领域有用的能力：**NEP（New Economics Papers）** 按主题把 RePEc 新增文献编成邮件报告，其中 **NEP-IAS「Insurance Economics」** 即保险专题（由 Thomas Krichel 编辑，每期约 12 篇；归档页显示统计截至 2024-12-31，并另有 Bluesky 频道）；**软件组件索引**（`/i/c.html`，当前收录 37 个软件系列）；以及作者/机构排名与 RePEc Biblio 主题书单。

对 RIAA：做**文献综述**时，JEL G22 是「这个领域的学术文献全集在哪」的标准答案——它比通用搜索更结构化（按 JEL 编码 + 可按系列/作者/机构筛选），而 RePEc 只收录有工作论文系列背书的来源，因此噪声低于 Google Scholar 一类的全网检索；NEP-IAS 则是以最低成本（邮件订阅）追踪「最近新增了哪些保险经济学研究」的方式。与本 wiki 研究类条目互补：开放教材见 [[actuarial-open-book]]、[[loss-data-analytics]]，SSRN 来源的研究条目见 [[ai-in-actuarial-science]]、[[experience-rating-insurance-pricing]]，预印本见 [[actuarial-ratemaking-scaling-laws]]，行业研究见 [[geneva-association]]、[[cas-research-tools]]，学科期刊见 [[astin-bulletin]]；适合作文献综述、选题调研与学术方向规划。

**核实说明**：NEP-IAS 的 `/latest` 在核实当时返回的是较早一期（2022-07-18），而归档页显示的统计截至 2024-12-31——因此**该报告的更新节奏需以归档页或 Bluesky 频道为准**，不要假定它仍按原频率出刊。
e.body_en:
RePEc (Research Papers in Economics) and its portal IDEAS (`ideas.repec.org`) are **the global literature library for economics and finance research**, and their browse-by-JEL-classification page for **G22, "Insurance; Insurance Companies; Actuarial Studies"**, is **the canonical gateway to insurance and actuarial academic literature** — gathering working papers, journal articles, book chapters and software under the discipline’s classification code (G22 sits under G2 "Financial Institutions and Services", itself under G "Financial Economics"; the paginated listings and a "follow this JEL code" subscription are verifiable). The platform offers several further capabilities useful in this field: **NEP (New Economics Papers)**, which filters new RePEc additions into edited email reports by topic — including **NEP-IAS, "Insurance Economics"** (edited by Thomas Krichel, roughly 12 papers per issue; the archive page shows statistics as of 2024-12-31, and there is also a Bluesky channel); a **software components index** (`/i/c.html`, currently covering 37 software series); and author/institution rankings plus RePEc Biblio reading lists.

For RIAA: for a **literature review**, JEL G22 is the standard answer to "where is the full set of academic literature in this field" — more structured than general search (by JEL code, filterable by series, author and institution), and because RePEc only indexes sources backed by a working-paper series, it is less noisy than whole-web search such as Google Scholar; NEP-IAS is the lowest-cost way (email subscription) to track "what insurance economics research was just added". It complements this wiki’s research entries: open textbooks in [[actuarial-open-book]] and [[loss-data-analytics]], SSRN-sourced research entries in [[ai-in-actuarial-science]] and [[experience-rating-insurance-pricing]], preprints in [[actuarial-ratemaking-scaling-laws]], industry research in [[geneva-association]] and [[cas-research-tools]], and the discipline’s journal in [[astin-bulletin]]; suits literature reviews, topic scoping and academic planning.

**Verification note**: at the time of verification NEP-IAS’s `/latest` returned an earlier issue (2022-07-18) while the archive page showed statistics as of 2024-12-31 — so **treat the archive page or the Bluesky channel as authoritative for the report’s current cadence** and do not assume it still publishes at its original frequency.
e.body_hk:
RePEc（Research Papers in Economics）及其門戶 IDEAS（`ideas.repec.org`）是**經濟學與金融研究的全球文獻庫**，其按 **JEL 分類**瀏覽的 **G22「Insurance; Insurance Companies; Actuarial Studies」（保險；保險公司；精算研究）**頁面是**保險與精算學術文獻的規範入口**——把工作論文、期刊文章、書籍章節與軟件按學科編碼歸集（G22 隸屬 G2「金融機構與服務」，上承 G「金融經濟學」）。平台另有幾項對本領域有用的能力：**NEP（New Economics Papers）** 按主題把 RePEc 新增文獻編成郵件報告，其中 **NEP-IAS「Insurance Economics」** 即保險專題（由 Thomas Krichel 編輯，每期約 12 篇；歸檔頁顯示統計截至 2024-12-31，並另有 Bluesky 頻道）；**軟件組件索引**（`/i/c.html`，當前收錄 37 個軟件系列）；以及作者/機構排名與 RePEc Biblio 主題書單。

對 RIAA：做**文獻綜述**時，JEL G22 是「這個領域的學術文獻全集在哪」的標準答案——比通用搜索更結構化，且 RePEc 只收錄有工作論文系列背書的來源，噪聲低於全網檢索；NEP-IAS 則是以最低成本（郵件訂閱）追蹤「最近新增了哪些保險經濟學研究」的方式。與本 wiki 研究類條目互補：開放教材見 [[actuarial-open-book]]、[[loss-data-analytics]]，SSRN 來源見 [[ai-in-actuarial-science]]、[[experience-rating-insurance-pricing]]，預印本見 [[actuarial-ratemaking-scaling-laws]]，行業研究見 [[geneva-association]]、[[cas-research-tools]]，學科期刊見 [[astin-bulletin]]；適合作文獻綜述、選題調研與學術方向規劃。

**核實說明**：NEP-IAS 的 `/latest` 在核實當時返回的是較早一期（2022-07-18），而歸檔頁顯示統計截至 2024-12-31——因此**該報告的更新節奏需以歸檔頁或 Bluesky 頻道為準**。
